svg.title: Arndt Bohrenkämper — personal LCARS logbook
svg.desc: Complete personal logbook of Arndt Bohrenkämper: personal background; AQVIONIS experimental AI-assisted security research; computing, AI, security and philosophy; Star Trek, retro gaming and martial arts; curiosity and lifelong learning. Readable mobile layout with orange and lavender LCARS rails on black.

g.aria-label: TO BOLDLY GO WHERE NO ONE
g.title: TO BOLDLY GO WHERE NO ONE

g.text: Personal log. I've spent a fair amount
My route hasn't followed a standard
with a simple question: Why does it
The ship's computer is excellent at
I find the unanswered ones even
the stranger the inventory, the better.
Admit what you don't know. Then
The universe is far too interesting to
